distribution.title: Data is gathered by conducting a survey to identify first responder's training needs.

dataset.title: Questionnaire for First Responders

dmp.description: This project aims to enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of first responder training in Liepaja by utilizing open data, evidence-based pedagogical strategies and such advanced technologies as digital twins to create a virtual training environment. The project activities include conducting learners' needs assessments using data gathered through questionnaires, researching pedagogical strategies for XR technology, exploring AI platforms, and developing a conceptual model for a training platform.
